items.headline: Kremlin ka Ukraine par yuddh badhane ka aarop
items.detail: Kremlin pravakta Dmitry Peskov ne kaha Ukraine yuddh ko Mediterranean aur Baltic sagar tak badha raha hai; ye bayan America aur NATO pramukh ki sanyukt chetavni ke baad aaya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, NATO — UPSC IR

items.headline: UK net migration 1997 ke baad sabse kam
items.detail: ONS ke mutabik June 2026 tak ke saal me UK ki net migration 77,000 rahi, 1997 ke baad sabse kam; pichhle saal ye 204,000 thi.
items.exam_angle: UK pravasan, ONS aankde — UPSC IR

items.headline: Zaporizhzhia me drone hamla, 5 ki maut
items.detail: Russia-niyukt Zaporizhzhia governor Yevgeny Balitsky ke mutabik Ukraine ke drone ne Vesioloye me parking par hamla kiya, 5 log mare aur 3 ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Russia-Ukraine ka sabse bada kaidi adla-badli jald
items.detail: America ke vishesh doot Jared Kushner ne kaha ki Russia aur Ukraine ke beech yuddh ka sabse bada kaidi adla-badli Christmas se pehle hoga; hazaron log apne parivaron ke paas lautenge.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, kaidi adla-badli, Abu Dhabi vartalap — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: US Mission to the European Union, Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

items.headline: North Korea ne Swiss doot ko nikala
items.detail: North Korea ne Pyongyang sthit Switzerland ke rajnaitik karyalaya ko band karne aur uske pramukh Sylvain Astier ko 48 ghante me desh chhodne ka aadesh diya; wajah Switzerland ka ek bachchon ke shivir par pratibandh hai.
items.exam_angle: North Korea, Switzerland, pratibandh, Ukraine ke bachche — UPSC IR

items.headline: EU neta saat saal ke budget par bante
items.detail: Brussels me EU ke 27 neta 2028–2034 ke lagbhag 1.6 lakh crore euro ke budget aur Ukraine ke liye 45 arab euro ke naye karz par bante hue hain; samjhota December me hone ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: EU budget, MFF, Ukraine vitt — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kroger 3,000 corporate naukri khatm karega
items.detail: America ki sabse badi traditional grocery chain Kroger ne corporate chhantni shuru kar di hai; teen saal me lagbhag 3,000 naukriyan khatm hongi, jabki Bengaluru me naya Capability Center khul raha hai.
items.exam_angle: US job market, offshoring, Bharat me GCC — UPSC economy

items.headline: Congo me Ebola ke 12,000 se zyada case
items.detail: Congo me Ebola ke confirmed case 12,021 ho gaye hain aur 5,904 logon ki maut hui hai; ladai ke karan roktham ka kaam mushkil ho raha hai, sarkari data ne bataya.
items.exam_angle: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, WHO — UPSC health

items.headline: UK ne 1 lakh purv sainikon ko patra likha
items.detail: Britain ne Cold War ke baad pehli baar lagbhag 1 lakh purv sainikon ko patra likhkar unke sampark, naukri aur kaushal ki jankari mangi hai, taaki Strategic Reserve taiyar rahe.
items.exam_angle: UK Strategic Reserve, NATO, Europe suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: OPEC ne COP31 haar ka dosh EU par dala
items.detail: OPEC pramukh Haitham Al Ghais ne kaha tel utpadak deshon ne COP31 me 'good faith' se hissa liya aur Antalya vartao ke bhang hone ke liye EU zimmedar hai.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu vartao, OPEC — UPSC environment

items.headline: America me toofan se 3.5 lakh ghar bijli-vihin
items.detail: Thanksgiving par America bhar me toofan aur barfbari se 3.5 lakh se zyada gharon ki bijli chali gayi; sabse zyada asar Missouri aur Virginia me raha, PowerOutage.us ke anusar.

items.headline: Houthi ka Saudi bandargahon par hamla
items.detail: Houthi ne Saudi Arabia ke Jizan bandargah par hamla kiya aur Jeddah ki taraf drone bheja; Saudi suraksha balon ne Riyadh ki taraf aati do ballistic missile aur Jeddah ke paas drone ko roka.
items.exam_angle: Lal Sagar, Houthi-Saudi sangharsh, samudri suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Russia ke hamle se Ukraine me 5 ki maut
items.detail: Russia ke raat bhar ke hamlo me Ukraine me kam se kam 5 log mare gaye aur paanch kshetron me bijli gul ho gayi; Odesa me 2 mare aur Kyiv me ek apartment building me aag lag gayi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja buniyadi dhancha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Islamabad me Makkah raksha samjhota baithak
items.detail: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia aur Türkiye ke mantri Islamabad me Makkah raksha samjhote ko vyavharik roop dene par do din ki baithak karenge.
items.exam_angle: Makkah raksha samjhota, samuhik suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza me Hamas suraksha pramukh mare gaye
items.detail: Israel ke hawai hamle me Hamas ke uttari Gaza suraksha pramukh Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, unki patni aur do betiyan mare gaye; do din me mare gaye doosre varishth adhikari hain.
items.exam_angle: Gaza, Hamas, Israel — UPSC IR

items.headline: Sudan me drone hamle, 19 nagrik mare
items.detail: Sudan ke Blue Nile rajya me RSF ke drone hamlo me kam se kam 19 nagrik mare gaye aur 20 se zyada ghayal hue, adhikar samuh Emergency Lawyers ne bataya.
items.exam_angle: Sudan grih yuddh, RSF drone yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hormuz me LNG tanker par mine hamla
items.detail: Iran ke Revolutionary Guards ke mutabik, Hormuz Strait me ek LNG tanker samudri mine se takrakar aag me jal utha; usi din do tel tanker bhi mine ki chapat me aaye.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait, tel vyapar, Iran — UPSC IR

items.headline: Har American bachche ko do SpaceX share
items.detail: Elon Musk ne kaha, America ke har bachche ko SpaceX ke do share milenge — ek company se, ek unki taraf se; kul keemat lagbhag 18 arab dollar.
items.exam_angle: Trump Account, SpaceX, AI boom — UPSC Economy

items.headline: Pakistan ke pehle astronaut Tiangong pahunche
items.detail: Pakistan ke Muhammad Zeeshan Ali Shenzhou-24 mission ke saath China ke Tiangong space station par pahunchne wale pehle videshi astronaut bane.
items.exam_angle: China-Pakistan space sahyog, Tiangong — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cairo me tanker aag, 31 ki maut
items.detail: Cairo ki ring road par petrol tanker palatne se lagi aag me kam se kam 31 log mare gaye aur 21 ghayal hue, Egypt ke swasthya mantralaya ne bataya.
items.exam_angle: Egypt me badi sadak durghatna — UPSC IR

items.headline: Huawei ko America me doshi thahraya gaya
items.detail: Brooklyn court ki jury ne Huawei ko vyapar rahasya chori ki sajish aur bank dhokhadhadi samet 12 me se 10 aaropon me doshi thahraya, saza September 2027 me hogi.
items.exam_angle: America-China tech yuddh, pratibandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: China: Shanghai neta Chen Jining par jaanch
items.detail: China ne Shanghai ke party pramukh aur Politburo sadasya Chen Jining ke khilaf bhrashtachar ki jaanch shuru ki, do saal me giraye gaye chaunthe Politburo sadasya bane.
items.exam_angle: China ki rajneeti, bhrashtachar abhiyan — UPSC IR

items.headline: America ne nagrikon ko Iran chhodne ko kaha
items.detail: America ke Virtual Embassy ne nagrikon se turant Iran chhodne ko kaha, kyunki Iran aur Houthi ke hamlo ke baad ladai tezi se badhne ka khatra hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav, travel advisory — UPSC IR

items.headline: Houthi ka Saudi ki sabse badi refinery par hamla
items.detail: Houthi ne Saudi Arabia ki sabse badi Ras Tanura refinery par hamle ka dava kiya; satellite tasveeron me dhuaan dikha aur tel ke daam 3.5% chadh gaye.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me tel suraksha, Houthi sangharsh — UPSC IR
